metadata.title: Robinhood shares slide after earnings, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
4 hours ago
Robinhood shares slide after earnings, and other early market movers
Here are some of stocks making notable moves in Wednesday's premarket action:
Shares of Robinhood Markets are sliding more than 8% after the trading platform revealed a dip in profits compared to the same quarter last year as activity in crypto assets declined sharply.
U.S.-listed shares of SK Hynix are jumping nearly 8% after the South Korean memory-chip maker posted net profits that more than tripled in the third quarter and it announced plans to return nearly $75 billion to shareholders.
The strong SK Hynix earnings are bolstering its U.S. peers, with shares of Micron Technology gaining 4% and Sandisk adding nearly 5%.
Seagate Technology shares are down more than 3% after its record-breaking earnings were not enough to support a stock that's surged 142.5% so far in 2026.
Enphase Energy shares are diving 17% after after the battery and solar company fell short of earnings expectations and lowered its outlook, citing weak residential demand.
